dialogues.speaker: Glenfidia
dialogues.text: Looking at the address, this should be the place...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, Paimon's in position, let's do this, Glenfidia!

dialogues.speaker: Glenfidia
dialogues.text: They ordered two cups of Golden Eden. I've prepared them according to the regular recipe.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No problem! Paimon's here to deliver a pleasant surprise!
